name: git-go
description: Visual representation of your Git repository, with actions to manage commits, branches, stashes, and tags.

git-go.graph.rounded.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Use rounded corners for all commit graph elements.

git-go.graph.theme.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Color theme for the commit graph branches and dots.

git-go.graph.customColors.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Custom color palette for branches. Theme needs to be set to 'custom'. Use hex color codes (e.g., #3b82f6).

git-go.graph.expandedCommitHeight.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Height in pixels for expanded commit details view.

git-go.graph.showCommitterName.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Show the committer name next to each commit in the graph.

git-go.graph.remoteAvatars.markdownDescription: **Graph Appearance:** Show author profile pictures from the repository's remote (GitHub), falling back to Gravatar. When disabled, only Gravatar is used.

git-go.autoOpen.enabled.markdownDescription: **Auto-Open Behavior:** Automatically open Git Go when VS Code opens in a git repository.

git-go.autoOpen.pinTab.markdownDescription: **Auto-Open Behavior:** Automatically pin the Git Go tab when opened.

git-go.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: **Interface Elements:** Show a Status Bar Item that opens the Git Go Graph when clicked.

git-go.file.openInSplitView.markdownDescription: **File Operations:** Open files and diffs in a split view next to Git Go, reusing an existing split view when there is one.

git-go.dragAndDrop.enabled.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Enable dragging branches, tags and commits in the graph to perform Git actions.

git-go.dragAndDrop.branchOnBranch.defaul.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Action performed when dropping a branch onto another branch. Set to 'none' to require picking an action from the boxes that appear when holding.

git-go.dragAndDrop.holdDelay.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Milliseconds to hold over a branch while dragging before its extra actions appear.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.merge.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a branch onto another branch, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.rebase.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a branch onto another branch with rebase selected, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.cherryPick.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a commit onto a branch, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.mergeCommit.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a commit onto a branch with merge selected, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.push.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a branch or tag onto its own push action, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.fetchIntoLocal.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Run the action straight away when dropping a remote branch onto its own fetch action, using the values its dialog would have opened with, instead of showing the dialog.

git-go.dragAndDrop.hideDelay.markdownDescription: **Drag and Drop:** Milliseconds the actions linger after the pointer moves away, so returning within that time keeps them open.

git-go.branch.create.checkout.markdownDescription: **Branch Operations:** Default value for 'Checkout new branch' when creating a branch.

git-go.branch.delete.force.markdownDescription: **Branch Operations:** Default value for 'Force delete' when deleting a branch.

git-go.branch.push.setUpstream.markdownDescription: **Branch Operations:** Default value for 'Set upstream' when pushing a branch.

git-go.branch.rebase.ignoreDate.markdownDescription: **Branch Operations:** Default value for 'Ignore date' when rebasing a branch.

git-go.merge.fastForwardIfPossible.markdownDescription: **Merge Operations:** Default value for 'Fast forward if possible' when merging branches.

git-go.merge.squash.markdownDescription: **Merge Operations:** Default value for 'Squash commits' when merging branches.

git-go.merge.noCommit.markdownDescription: **Merge Operations:** Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when merging branches.

git-go.cherryPick.recordOrigin.markdownDescription: **Cherry-Pick Operations:** Default value for 'Record origin' when cherry-picking commits.

git-go.cherryPick.noCommit.markdownDescription: **Cherry-Pick Operations:** Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when cherry-picking commits.

git-go.revert.noCommit.markdownDescription: **Revert Operations:** Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when reverting commits.

git-go.reset.mode.markdownDescription: **Reset Operations:** Default reset mode when resetting the current branch to a commit.

git-go.remote.fetch.forceFetch.markdownDescription: **Remote Operations:** Default value for 'Force fetch' when fetching remote branches into local branches.

git-go.remote.fetch.checkout.markdownDescription: **Remote Operations:** Default value for 'Checkout branch after fetch' when fetching remote branches into local branches.

git-go.remote.fetch.confirmOnlyIfForceNe.markdownDescription: **Remote Operations:** Only show the confirmation dialog when fetching a remote branch into a local branch if the local branch has commits the remote branch does not, so the fetch needs to be forced. Otherwise the fetch runs straight away using the configured defaults.

git-go.stash.includeUntracked.markdownDescription: **Stash Operations:** Default value for 'Include untracked files' when creating stashes.

git-go.worktree.defaultPath.markdownDescription: **Worktree Operations:** Default path template for new worktrees, relative to the repository root. `{repo}` is replaced with the repository name and `{branch}` with the branch name.

git-go.worktree.openNewWindow.markdownDescription: **Worktree Operations:** Default value for 'Open in new window' when creating or opening a worktree.

enumDescriptions: Ask every time whether to open the worktree in a new window or the current one
Always open worktrees in a new window
Always open worktrees in the current window
git-go.worktree.openBehavior.markdownDescription: **Worktree Operations:** What to do when opening a worktree.

scripts.build: pnpm run compile && cd panel && pnpm run build
